# All About Our Cliff’s Builders Neighborhoods

# Meet Cliffs Builders

[Cliffs Builders](https://cliffsliving.com/real-estate/build/cliffs-builders/) is the state-of-the-art homebuilding program offered at The Cliffs. This solution perfectly combines custom-built opulence with semi-custom simplicity. Cliffs Builders partners with architects, craftsmen, and an in-house design team to provide an efficient and professional construction process that lessens a buyer’s wait time to step through the front door of their new home.

## How The Cliffs Builders Program Works

### 1\. Find Your Ideal Homesite

One of our [Cliffs Realty](https://cliffsliving.com/real-estate/) sales executives will help you find your ideal homesite in one of our neighborhoods or one of our hand-selected homesites in Mountain Park or Walnut Cove. If you are curious and would like to view a few homesites now, reach out to us below, and we will help you find the ideal homesite for your Cliffs Builders home.

### 2\. Choose a Floor Plan

Each of our Cliffs Builders neighborhoods offer multiple floor plans. Based on the neighborhood, floor plans may be preselected for a homesite, or our team can help you select one that meets all your needs while maximizing the use of the available space.

### 3\. Time to Customize

Now that you have selected your homesite and floor plan, it’s time to customize your home. Our design team will walk you through your interior selections, including paint colors, appliances, flooring, lighting, and more. They can even help with furniture packages to make move-in day even easier.

### 4\. Move-In Day

Once your home is built and all of your customizations are complete, we offer a walk-through of the property to show the proper operation of your new home. Additionally, we offer a 1-year workmanship warranty, giving our residents the peace of mind they deserve.

## Four Featured Cliffs Builders Neighborhoods

### Waterscape at Keowee Springs

This lakeside enclave demonstrates the clean lines and modern styling often found in the designs of multiple award-winning Lake \| Flato Architects. [The Waterscape at Keowee Springs’](https://cliffsliving.com/community/new-release/waterscape-at-keowee-springs/) 19 homesites are divided into two unique sections—The Cove and The Treetops.

At the neighboring [Lake Club](https://cliffsliving.com/blog/%25blog-category%25/the-lake-club-at-the-cliffs/), Waterscape residents have access to a host of luxurious amenities, including two pools, a gym, racquet courts, food and beverage service, and adventures on the lake with available kayaks and paddleboards. For those looking for things to do nearby, Clemson is only 14 miles away and  more than just a college football town. This Blue Ridge Mountain community is loved for its growing art scene, engaging eateries, bars, boutique shopping, and impressive parks.

### Clubhouse Village at Keowee Springs

At [Clubhouse Village at Keowee Springs](https://cliffsliving.com/community/new-release/clubhouse-village-at-keowee-springs/), members are never far from an active outdoor lifestyle and a full social calendar. The 29 homesites are mere steps away from all of the action. With various options, ranging from cozy getaway cottages to lavish year-round estates, all seven floor plans showcase [Hart Howerton’s](https://www.harthowerton.com/) impeccable design.

[The Keowee Springs Clubhouse](https://cliffsliving.com/blog/amenities/introducing-keowee-springs-clubhouse-the-newest-amenity-at-the-cliffs/), also designed by Hart Howerton, serves as the central hub for fine dining, wellness, and spectacular views of the [Tom Fazio golf course](https://cliffsliving.com/golf-course/keowee-springs-golf/). This family-friendly, 72-par course showcases Fazio’s impeccable design.

### Cove Park at Walnut Cove

Styled to mirror classic Southern charm, [Cove Park at Walnut Cove](https://cliffsliving.com/community/new-release/cove-park-at-walnut-cove/) is a close-knit neighborhood positioned along picturesque walking trails. With a state-of-the-art wellness center and a short drive to the Club Village, this existing neighborhood offers 11 new homesites with your choice of three home plans.

For those who enjoy entertaining, all three of the floorplans invite effortless indoor and outdoor entertaining with easy-flow open floor plans. Only a short 15-mile drive away, Asheville offers an abundance of activities for Cove Park residents to choose from.

**Related:** [Top Five Things To Do In Asheville](https://cliffsliving.com/blog/around-town/top-five-things-to-do-in-asheville/)

### Golf Ridge at Mountain Park

This enclave, perched along the southernmost ridge of the Blue Ridge Mountains, immerses its residents in beautiful golf course views. With Gary Player’s acclaimed Mountain Park course as a backdrop to the 19 semi-custom homes within Golf Ridge, there isn’t a bad seat in the house. These sizable homesites range anywhere from .75 to 1.0 acres, providing ample space for the home of your dreams.

Just 21 miles from Hendersonville and 20 miles from downtown Greenville, small-town charm is never far from [Golf Ridge](https://cliffsliving.com/community/new-release/golf-ridge-at-mountain-park/). All floorplans have easy-flow living spaces for effortless indoor and outdoor entertainment.

## Choose a Life of Luxury at The Cliffs

Life at The Cliffs is filled with abundant nature, luxurious amenities, and various wellness activities rivaling even the most lavish resorts. With [seven communities](https://cliffsliving.com/communities/) to choose from, The Cliffs has something for everyone. Contact our team below to find your dream home today.

While many of our team members specialize in commercial, industrial, and distribution type projects, the diverse backgrounds of our architects and engineers grant our architecture firm success across many architectural design projects.

Many of our team members are based in the greater [Reno](https://www.tectonicsdesigngroup.com/about/why-reno/) area and work from our South Reno office. At the core of the firm’s culture is the belief that function, aesthetics, and value are not mutually exclusive. # Balancing Possibilities & Feasibility

The ‘Pre-Design Phase’ is the point at which we visit your space or building site and begin to **merge vision and reality.** This is a tender and challenging moment that our designers are masterful at navigating with clarity & compassion.

Analysis of distinctive site features including solar orientation, topography, vegetation, renewable energy potential, water supply, and waste water and utility infrastructure are considered as well as zoning and permitting requirements. We intersect this comprehensive analysis with details about your space requirements, desired design style, and energy efficiency goals to begin to reveal the fundamental elements that compose your project.

**Now is the time to be direct about your budget and timeline** so we may build a strong foundation upon which to bring your project into being.

# Pencil & Paper

A lot happens before it's time to put pencil to paper, and once we've reached that point it's an exciting moment in every project.

Utilizing what we have learned, hand-rendered drawings of your site, building, landscape or interior are created to explore how your project might inhibit its setting. An initial opinion of cost is an essential ingredient of this step, helping you evaluate how your design decisions impact your budget, and guiding our work.

![](https://cushmandesign.com/assets/components/phpthumbof/cache/modern-lakefront_web.efd04dd44f3bcca7624e7acc3c8c85b5.d5c233e9ba7ed761065b1cb420c6a1b1.webP)

# Develop Your Design

As concepts emerge, you and our designers come to share the same vision. **We’re aligned.** We know how we’d like the finished space to look and feel, and it’s time to bring it into being. At this point, we become more granular, assessing structural, mechanical and electrical systems while refining the dimensions of the project.

We thoughtfully explore materials and textures with you to define the finished quality of your project, and continue collaboration with your contractor to develop and refine their pricing.

![](https://cushmandesign.com/assets/components/phpthumbof/cache/greatroom-web.219cfcbf49ee9b3315ca474e6ae964d4.059bafb873a9f9e4ebb51bba47755f55.webP)

# Craft Construction Documents

The work of translating your vision into an architectural form has been a journey, rich in both creativity and information. Now it’s time to create comprehensive sets of construction documents for your contractor. These documents serve as the road map for a construction contract.

**Traditionally called “blueprints” construction drawings carefully define design intent, dimensions, assemblies, details, and relationships; and create the framework with which interior design, material selection, and fixture and furniture selection can be advanced.**

These documents may include written specifications for site work, architectural, structural, and electrical plans as well as contain pertinent door, window, plumbing, and finish schedules.

![](https://cushmandesign.com/assets/components/phpthumbof/cache/haven%20site%20visit.995693bfb80856c1e905e78f1be7081e.c37aee4e481d089d735f9203264238b1.webP)

# Design, Collaborate, Build

For many of our clients, recommended contractors are interviewed as early as the schematic design phase and often selected at that time to guide decision-making with pricing, feedback and to collaborate on defining the project’s scope. Our team also works with contractors who are brought in by our clients.

**We enjoy the deep and meaningful relationship built between client, contractor and designer.**

![](https://cushmandesign.com/assets/components/phpthumbof/cache/17-1218_0367.c2a94a58a0fab0837ae1aef67968ab81.afc0267cfe5963e464d677b84c23e70f.webP)

# Under Construction

Finally, the nails and studs! Concrete and wood! Ideas are now being crafted into three dimensions and your project is under construction. Communicating the unique design elements of your project requires hands-on attention in order to be successfully built.

**Our designers apply robust experience to working through questions and details with your contractor on the job site, as we continue to guide the process while you watch your project unfold and grow.**

While on the job site, our design team will observe progress, address questions from the contractor and their sub-contractors, and provide supplemental information as needed with the goal of ensuring that your intention and vision are translated accurately into physical form.

![](https://cushmandesign.com/assets/components/phpthumbof/cache/master_bath_vig_2.3507dd3a6d3117cf68812a928848eb82.afc0267cfe5963e464d677b84c23e70f.webP)

# From a House, to a Home

A space is now built, and is becoming a home for you or for your business. **Making the space your own - fully embodying it - is the task at hand.** Our designers have rich experience fully integrating and harmonizing the aesthetic intent of our work, designing the details that once crafted will elevate your intention to its most elegant realization.

We collaborate with you to design and select:

- Details and materials
- Paint and stain colors
- Kitchens and bathrooms
- Built-in cabinetry and furniture
- Lighting, including custom works
- Fireplaces
- Stairways
- Landscape design and site planning
- On-site renewable energy systems

We believe that the thoughtful integration of the building into the landscape is an essential aspect of architectural design.
